items.title: Edgevana Signs $700 Million in AI Infrastructure Agreements as Committed Demand Reaches $7 Billion
items.summary: Edgevana, the data center, energy and compute orchestration platform delivering production-ready AI compute, today announced more than $700 million in fully committed, multi-year take-or-pay agreements to deploy NVIDIA Blackwell computing systems across North America and Europe. The commitment comes as power constraints delay traditional data center builds, driving $7 billion in contracted customer demand and an active pipeline exceeding $20 billion for Edgevana's pre-energized platform.
